content: The goals of Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) for individuals with diabetes are as follows: 1. Encourage the adoption of healthful eating patterns by promoting the consumption of nutrient-dense foods in appropriate portion sizes. This approach aims to enhance overall health, support the achievement of a healthy body weight, and help maintain blood glucose and blood pressure levels within target ranges. 2. Tailor nutritional recommendations to meet the unique needs of each individual. This includes taking into account cultural and personal preferences, health literacy levels, and the accessibility of healthy food options. 3. Empower individuals by equipping them with the knowledge necessary to make informed dietary choices. This also involves fostering their confidence in managing their own diet effectively. 4. Emphasize the use of practical tools and strategies to develop sustainable and healthy eating habits. Instead of focusing on specific macronutrients or individual foods, the goal is to provide actionable guidance that supports long-term dietary improvements.
